scope: nitrogen incorporation into the diamond lattice and surface effects during CVD growth; DFT-Kinetics-COMSOL

sources.title: Nitrogen overgrowth as a catalytic mechanism during diamond chemical vapour deposition
sources.finding: Proposes a DFT mechanism in which surface-embedded N promotes new-layer nucleation at C–N dimers.
sources.need: Compare N-free and surface-embedded N structures, ring opening/closing, and incorporation pathways
sources.caution: The reported ~400-fold enhancement concerns a specific reaction step, not the overall growth rate. Verify barriers, temperature, and calculation settings against the paper/SI before entry.

sources.title: Two-dimensional modeling of diamond growth by microwave plasma activated chemical vapor deposition
sources.finding: Links gas-phase distributions with growth rates and proposes N-based anchors affecting CH₂ migration and incorporation.
sources.need: Growth model separating local H/CH₃ supply, Tₛ, and nitrogen surface states
sources.locator: Section 3: growth rate; Section 4: anchor mechanism
sources.caution: Treat anchors as a hypothesis to test. Do not equate inlet N₂ concentration with surface N coverage.

sources.title: Automated MUltiscale simulation environment (AMUSE)
sources.finding: Connects DFT results → reaction networks → microkinetics → CFD. AutoProfLib, PyMKM, and reproducible examples are available.
sources.need: Postprocessing data structures, reaction-network generation, and kinetics-to-CFD transfer
sources.locator: Official README; paper workflow and examples
sources.caution: A catalytic-reaction workflow, not a ready-made diamond plasma growth tool. COMSOL integration requires separate development.

sources.title: Making atomistic materials calculations accessible with the AiiDAlab Quantum ESPRESSO app
sources.authors: Wang et al. · npj Computational Materials 12, 72
sources.finding: Implements web-based DFT setup, submission, monitoring, visualization, and provenance tracking.
sources.need: Reference interface for input generation, HPC submission, and result retrieval
sources.locator: Architecture; QE app wizard UI; Code availability
sources.caution: Check surface-reaction/NEB template suitability and support for the installed engine separately.

sources.title: Substitutional n-type doping of diamond
sources.finding: Thermodynamically studies chemisorption of species including NHx, surface substitution and subsequent bulk incorporation using DFT/HF.
sources.need: Compare structures and energies for adsorbed N species, surface substitutional N and bulk N.
sources.caution: A preliminary thermodynamic study; transition states and rate constants for all steps are not validated. Separate N, P and S results and verify numerical data against the full paper.

sources.title: A theoretical study of the effect of nitrogen, boron and phosphorus impurities on the growth and morphology of diamond surfaces
sources.authors: Zoya Mehmood Shah & Alison Mainwood · Diamond Relat. Mater. 17, 1307–1310
sources.finding: Uses DFT to compare impurity incorporation on different diamond growth faces and examines growth-sector preferences and hydrogen termination.
sources.need: Compare substitutional N stability by surface orientation, termination and depth.
sources.status: Publisher abstract and public excerpts checked
sources.caution: Results depend on the surface model and impurity species. Stability and binding energies are not incorporation activation barriers.

sources.title: A Theoretical Study of Nitrogen-Induced Effects on Initial Steps of Diamond CVD Growth
sources.authors: Tanguy Van Regemorter & Karin Larsson · Chemical Vapor Deposition 14, 224–231
sources.finding: Compares CH3 adsorption and H abstraction from adsorbed CH3 for substitutional N positions on (111) and (100)-2x1 surfaces. Second-layer N affects the two reactions differently.
sources.need: Compare CH3 adsorption and H abstraction while controlling N depth and surface orientation.
sources.caution: Examines how already-substitutional N affects initial carbon growth reactions; it does not establish the complete gas-to-lattice nitrogen incorporation pathway.

sources.title: Microwave Plasma-Activated Chemical Vapor Deposition of Nitrogen-Doped Diamond. II: CH4/N2/H2 Plasmas
sources.authors: Truscott, Kelly, Potter, Ashfold & Mankelevich · J. Phys. Chem. A 120, 8537–8549
sources.finding: Combines spectroscopy and 2D kinetics/transport modeling to examine near-substrate N, NHx and CN supply and discuss candidate incorporation precursors under different process conditions.
sources.need: Distinguish N2 feed fraction from near-substrate reactive nitrogen concentrations when defining surface supply.
sources.caution: Gas-phase species concentrations are not lattice N concentrations or incorporation efficiencies. Discussed surface pathways are possibilities, not a universally established mechanism.

sources.title: Perfect alignment and preferential orientation of nitrogen-vacancy centers during CVD growth of diamond on (111) surfaces
sources.authors: Julia Michl et al. · Applied Physics Letters 104, 102407
sources.finding: Observes aligned NV centers during (111) CVD growth and presents experimental evidence supporting N incorporation into the growth surface before neighboring vacancy formation.
sources.need: Distinguish N incorporation from NV formation, including sequence and orientation during (111) growth.
sources.locator: Author preprint abstract; journal reference on arXiv
sources.caution: Do not generalize NV formation/alignment results to incorporation efficiencies for all substitutional N or to (100) growth rates.

sources.title: VASP — Input and Output: a short Intro
sources.authors: VASP Wiki · INCAR / POSCAR / KPOINTS / POTCAR
sources.finding: Defines input-file roles and outputs including OUTCAR, OSZICAR, and CONTCAR.
sources.need: Define VASP input packages and result parsers
sources.caution: Assemble POTCAR from the institution’s licensed library in species order. POTCAR files are not distributed in this mockup.

sources.title: Quantum ESPRESSO — pw.x / neb.x input descriptions
sources.finding: Defines SCF/relax namelists, atom/cell/k-point cards, and NEB path input formats.
sources.need: QE input generation, Ry/Bohr unit handling, and NEB image preparation
sources.caution: Do not copy numerical cutoffs or convergence thresholds directly from VASP. Validate UPFs, structures, spin, and surface settings.

sources.title: COMSOL — Application Library examples / Tubular Reactor
sources.finding: Examples and documentation for reactor apps with task-specific inputs and outputs.
sources.need: Reference for external kinetics inputs and reactor-result displays
sources.caution: Not a diamond growth model. Check the installed version, modules, and model-variable mapping separately.

reaction_candidates.purpose: Creation and removal of active N states
reaction_candidates.required_data: N positions, lifetimes, and incorporation pathways
